description: This Java class 'ImageTransform' provides services for image processing, including reading images, scaling images based on specified dimensions, parsing XML configuration files for image properties, and converting images to BufferedImage format.

classes.name: ImageTransform
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for image processing, including reading, scaling, XML parsing, and image format conversion.

methods.name: getBufferedImage
methods.description: Reads an image from a file location and returns a map with the BufferedImage and response message.

methods.name: scaleImage
methods.description: Scales a BufferedImage according to specified dimensions and returns the scaled image along with scale factor.

methods.name: getXMLValue
methods.description: Parses an XML file to extract configuration values into a map.

methods.name: toBufferedImage
methods.description: Converts a generic Image object to a BufferedImage.
